description: Withheld tonight's share and any Rose sum he had not got.
name: John Heminges

description: Kept the bill and the board as two truths, and waited on the glass.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Asked for a number, said Titus went without Will, and did not invent one on the road.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Named last Saturday's 36s, refused a guess, and kept the glass struck.
name: William Shakespeare
